title: CEDAR · The ring with the whistle in it
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: A cedar round on a sawhorse and a man with a stethoscope to it, listening to the 1994 ring, and the page drawing what he hears: the whistle's jagged shape, tiny, curled inside that one ring like a fossil. He marks the ring with a notch. The same notch as the woman's.
